import pytest

from orders.pricing import price_order


def test_sale_and_bulk_discounts_stack():
    items = [{"price": 10.0, "qty": 10, "sale": True}]
    assert price_order(items, "none") == 95.5


def test_tiers_and_coupons_add_up():
    items = [{"price": 100.0, "qty": 1}]
    assert price_order(items, "silver") == 105.0
    assert price_order(items, "bronze") == 108.0
    assert price_order(items, "gold", "SAVE10") == 90.0


def test_shipping_bands():
    assert price_order([{"price": 600.0, "qty": 1}], "none") == 600.0
    assert price_order([{"price": 200.0, "qty": 1}], "none") == 205.0
    assert price_order([{"price": 50.0, "qty": 1}], "none") == 60.0


def test_unknown_coupon_and_error_order():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unknown coupon: BOGUS"):
        price_order([{"price": 1.0, "qty": 1}], "none", "BOGUS")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):  # items are checked first
        price_order([{"price": 1.0, "qty": -1}], "none", "BOGUS")
